name: Structured
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Structured, turn tasks into a visual daily timeline with reminders and simple recurring items. The hard boundary is native mobile polish, widgets, apple sync, and accessibility refinement, plus cross-device reliability and workflow polish.
